output.summary: The blended win-rate drop is mostly a mix and measurement artifact. From 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold fell to 40 and opportunities began auto-creating, and 60-day auto-close followed. The 40-59 band is 750 of 1,720 closed opportunities and wins 3.3%. Excluding it, Q3 win rate is 29.4% against 31.0% in Q1. Non-marketing win rate is stable, which argues against complacency, comp, and Brannock pricing as drivers. Rep activity rose. Comp pay is flat or up. LeadSpring lowered the share of leads scoring 60 or above. Whether its high-score leads are intrinsically worse is unestablished. The response-time effect is confounded by the quote-requested flag. Re-baseline reporting and reroute the 40-59 leads. Do not run the accountability program.
